# What is the best clock for each organ 
Need to load in data first 
```{r g}
###############################################################
# Ranking models, computing performance metrics,
# and generating summary plots with significance annotations
#
# This script processes cross-organ methylation clock
# validation metrics, calculates composite performance scores,
# identifies best-performing models, and visualises performance
# across CpG grouping strategies with and without raw data.
###############################################################
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggh4x)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(rstatix)
library(scales)
library(tibble)
})
###############################################################
# --- 1. Compute ranking metrics and composite performance score
###############################################################

ranked <- metrics_data_validation %>%
  group_by(cpg_grouping, model, organ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Lower MAE indicates better accuracy → invert and rescale.
    mae_score = scales::rescale(-mae),

    # Higher R² is better → standard 0–1 normalisation.
    r2_score = scales::rescale(r_squared_value)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    # Composite continuous performance index for ranking models.
    performance_score = mae_score + r2_score,

    # Convert relevant descriptors to factors for consistent plotting/modeling.
    cpg_grouping = factor(cpg_grouping),
    tile_methode = factor(tile_methode),
    model = factor(model),
    organ = factor(organ),
    rsq_threshold = factor(rsq_threshold),
    filter = factor(filter),

    # Scale hyperparameters to stabilise mixed-effects fitting downstream.
    epse_scaled = scale(epse)
  )


###############################################################
# --- 2. Identify best model per organ
###############################################################

best <- ranked %>%
  group_by(organ) %>%
  # Highest performance score = optimal clock for that tissue.
  filter(performance_score == max(performance_score)) %>%
  # In case of ties, choose first deterministically.
  dplyr::slice(1)


###############################################################
# --- 3. Plot: performance across CpG groupings (no raw data)
###############################################################

# Compute significance for CpG groupings dynamically (if available).
signif_data <- get_signif_per_group(
  df = ranked,
  y_var = "performance_score",
  x_var = "cpg_grouping",
  group_var = "cpg_grouping"
)

p <- ggplot(
  ranked,
  aes(
    y = performance_score,
    x = factor(cpg_grouping),
    colour = factor(cpg_grouping),
    group = interaction(factor(cpg_grouping))
  )
) +
  # Mean trend line across x-axis categories.
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "line",
    size = 0.2,
    colour = "#999999",
    position = position_dodge(0.8),
    aes(group = cpg_grouping)
  ) +
  # SE bars around the mean.
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.10,
    position = position_dodge(0.8)
  ) +
  # Mean point markers.
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 2,
    position = position_dodge(0.8)
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = master_pal) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Performance Score",
    colour = ""
  ) +

  plot_theme +
  
   theme(legend.position = "bottom") 

# Add dynamic significance results if they exist.
if (!is.null(signif_data) && nrow(signif_data) > 0) {
  signif_data$y.position <- signif_data$y.position

  p <- p + stat_pvalue_manual(
    signif_data,
    label = "label",
    tip.length = 0.0001,
    hide.ns = FALSE,
    size = 4
  )
}
p
performance_cpg_grouping <- p
# Export figure.
ggsave(
  paste0(output_directory, "/best_model_summary.png"),
  performance_cpg_grouping,
  height = 7, 
  width = 9, 
  dpi = 400
)

# Compute significance for CpG groupings dynamically (if available).
signif_data <- get_signif_per_group(
  df = ranked,
  y_var = "performance_score",
  x_var = "organ",
  group_var = "organ"
)

p <- ggplot(
  ranked,
  aes(
    y = performance_score,
    x = factor(organ),
    colour = factor(organ),
    group = interaction(factor(organ)))
  
) +

  # SE bars around the mean.
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.10,
    position = position_dodge(0.8)
  ) +
  # Mean point markers.
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 2,
    position = position_dodge(0.8)
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = master_pal) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Performance Score",
    colour = ""
  ) +

  plot_theme +
  
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle=20,hjust=1)) 

# Add dynamic significance results if they exist.
if (!is.null(signif_data) && nrow(signif_data) > 0) {
  signif_data$y.position <- signif_data$y.position

  p <- p + stat_pvalue_manual(
    signif_data,
    label = "label",
    tip.length = 0.0001,
    hide.ns = FALSE,
    size = 4
  )
}
p
performance_organs<- p
# Export figure.
ggsave(
  paste0(output_directory, "/best_model_summary_organ.png"),
  performance_organs,
  height = 7, 
  width = 6, 
  dpi = 400
)

###############################################################
# --- 4. Plot performance + beeswarm raw data, facet by organ
###############################################################

# Pre-defined manually curated significance annotations per organ.
sig_data <- tibble::tribble(
  ~organ,        ~xmin, ~xmax, ~y_position, ~annotations,
  "Brain",         1,     3,      1.45,        "***",
  "Brain",         2,     3,      1.50,        "**",
  "Intestines",    1,     3,      1.21,        "***",
  "Multi_organ",    1,     3,      1.38,        "***"
)

p <- ggplot(
  ranked,
  aes(
    y = performance_score,
    x = cpg_grouping,
    colour = factor(cpg_grouping),
    group = interaction(organ, factor(cpg_grouping))
  )
) +
  # Raw data distribution with jitter control via beeswarm.
  ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(alpha = 0.15) +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.15,
    position = position_dodge(0.8)
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 2,
    position = position_dodge(0.8)
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = master_pal) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Performance Score",
    colour = ""
  ) +
  plot_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle=20,hjust=1)) +

  # Facet by organ; panels have independent y-axis scaling.
  facet_nested(~organ, scales = "free")

# Add manually defined significance bars.
p <- p +
  geom_segment(
    data = sig_data,
    aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = y_position, yend = y_position),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.5,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = sig_data,
    aes(
      x = (xmin + xmax) / 2,
      y = y_position + 0.025,
      label = annotations
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5
  )

p
performance_organs_x_cpg_grouping  <- p
ggsave(
  paste0(output_directory, "/best_model_summary_organ_beeswarm.png"),
  performance_organs_x_cpg_grouping,
  height = 7, 
  width = 9, 
  dpi = 400
)


###############################################################
# --- 5. Plot performance per organ, no raw data
###############################################################

# Repeat significance definitions (kept separate for clarity).
sig_data <- tibble::tribble(
  ~organ,        ~xmin, ~xmax, ~y_position, ~annotations,
  "Brain",         1,     3,      1.45,        "***",
  "Brain",         2,     3,      1.50,        "**",
  "Intestines",    1,     3,      1.21,        "***",
  "Multi_organ",    1,     3,      1.38,        "***"
)

p <- ggplot(
  ranked,
  aes(
    y = performance_score,
    x = cpg_grouping,
    colour = factor(cpg_grouping),
    group = interaction(organ, factor(cpg_grouping))
  )
) +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.15,
    position = position_dodge(0.8)
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 2,
    position = position_dodge(0.8)
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = master_pal) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Performance Score",
    colour = ""
  ) +

    theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle=20,hjust=1))  +
  plot_theme +
  facet_nested(~organ, scales = "free")

# Add significance layers.
p <- p +
  geom_segment(
    data = sig_data,
    aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = y_position, yend = y_position),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.5,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = sig_data,
    aes(
      x = (xmin + xmax) / 2,
      y = y_position + 0.025,
      label = annotations
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5
  )

p

ggsave(
  paste0(output_directory, "/best_model_summary_organ.png"),
  height = 7, width = 9, dpi = 400
)
```

## Significance Analysis
```{r h}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(purrr)
  library(lme4)
  library(car)
  library(emmeans)
})


# overall performance score per cpg grouping 

m <- lmer(
  performance_score ~ 
    organ*cpg_grouping +
    (1 | model_id),
  data = ranked
)
summary(m)
Anova(m, type="III")
emmeans(m, pairwise ~ organ)
emmeans(m, pairwise ~ cpg_grouping)
emmeans(m, pairwise ~ cpg_grouping|organ)


```



# What are cpgs which repeatidly become selected 

```{r h1}

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(GenomicRanges)

fraction_threshold <- 0.05  # fraction of runs for repeatability

# ---------------------------
# 1. Convert dataframe to GRanges
# ---------------------------
gr_all <- GRanges(
  seqnames = cpg_data_validation_long$chr,
  ranges   = IRanges(start = as.numeric(cpg_data_validation_long$start),
                     end   = as.numeric(cpg_data_validation_long$end)),
  cpg      = cpg_data_validation_long$selected_cpgs,
  organ    = cpg_data_validation_long$organ,
  model_id = cpg_data_validation_long$unique_model_id
)

# ---------------------------
# 2. Function to get repeatable regions per organ (k=1)
# ---------------------------
# Function to get repeatable regions per organ based on overlap
get_repeatable_regions <- function(gr, fraction_threshold = 0.05) {
  
  organs <- unique(gr$organ)
  
  repeatable_list <- map(organs, function(org_name) {
    
    message("Starting :", org_name)
    gr_org <- gr[gr$organ == org_name]
    n_runs <- length(unique(gr_org$model_id))
    threshold <- ceiling(fraction_threshold * n_runs)
    
    # Merge overlapping regions within this organ across all runs
    gr_reduced <- reduce(gr_org)
    
    # Count how many model runs overlap each reduced region
    counts <- sapply(seq_along(gr_reduced), function(i) {
      sum(countOverlaps(gr_org, gr_reduced[i]) > 0)
    })
    
    gr_repeatable <- gr_reduced[counts >= threshold]
    gr_repeatable$organ <- org_name
    gr_repeatable
  })
  
  names(repeatable_list) <- organs
  repeatable_list
}


# ---------------------------
# 3. Compute repeatable regions per organ (k=1)
# ---------------------------
# Get repeatable GRanges per organ
repeatable_per_organ <- get_repeatable_regions(gr_all, fraction_threshold = fraction_threshold)


# Prepare final tibble for k=1
k1_df <- map_df(repeatable_per_organ, function(gr) {
  tibble(
    organs = gr$organ[1],
    chr = as.character(seqnames(gr)),
    start = start(gr),
    end = end(gr)
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(k = "k1",
         Probe = paste(chr,start,end, sep=":")) %>%
  dplyr::select(k, organs, chr, start, end,Probe)

# ---------------------------
# 4. Prepare GRanges per organ for k>=2 
# ---------------------------
# Split the semicolon-delimited CpGs and ensure start/end are numeric
cpg_ranges <- cpg_data_validation_long %>%
  # filter(!organ %in% "Multi_organ") %>%
  dplyr::select(cpg_grouping,organ, selected_cpgs, chr, start, end) %>%
  mutate(
    selected_cpgs = trimws(selected_cpgs),
    start = as.numeric(start),
    end   = as.numeric(end)
  )

# Create GRanges list per organ
cpg_granges_list <- cpg_ranges %>%
  group_by(organ) %>%
  summarise(
    gr = list(GRanges(seqnames = chr, ranges = IRanges(start = start, end = end), cpg = selected_cpgs)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  deframe()  # named list: names = organs, values = GRanges


# ---------------------------
# 5. Compute cross-organ overlaps for k>=2 (exact CpG IDs)
# ---------------------------
organ_names <- names(cpg_granges_list)
overlap_results <- list()

for (k in 2:length(organ_names)) {  # start from 2
  
  combs <- combn(organ_names, k, simplify = FALSE)
  
  overlap_results[[paste0("k", k)]] <- map_df(combs, function(orgs_combo) {
    
    gr_list <- cpg_granges_list[orgs_combo]
    cpg_vectors <- lapply(gr_list, function(gr) gr$cpg)
    intersect_cpgs <- Reduce(intersect, cpg_vectors)
    
    if(length(intersect_cpgs) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    tibble(
      organs = paste(orgs_combo, collapse = ";"),
      cpg = intersect_cpgs
    )
    
  })
}

k2_plus_df <- bind_rows(overlap_results, .id = "k")

# remove large objects 
rm(gr_all, 
repeatable_per_organ ,
cpg_ranges,
cpg_granges_list )

# ---------------------------
# 6. Merge k=1 and k>=2
# ---------------------------
final_overlap_df <- bind_rows(k1_df, k2_plus_df)


# making vectors 

best_cpg_overlap_all <- final_overlap_df %>%
  filter(k == "k4") %>%
  pull(cpg)
best_cpg_overlap_single <-final_overlap_df %>%
  filter(organs == "Brain;Caudal_Fin;Intestines" ) %>%
  pull(cpg)

best_cpg_overlap_all_df <- final_overlap_df %>%
  filter(k == "k4") %>%
  dplyr::rename("selected_cpgs" ="cpg" )

best_cpg_overlap_single_df <-final_overlap_df %>%
  filter(organs == "Brain;Caudal_Fin;Intestines" )  %>%
  dplyr::rename("selected_cpgs" ="cpg" )

best_selected_cpgs_organs  <- list(
  Brain = final_overlap_df %>%
  filter(organs == "Brain" ) %>%
  pull(Probe),
  Caudal_Fin = final_overlap_df %>%
  filter(organs == "Caudal_Fin" ) %>%
  pull(Probe),
  Intestines = final_overlap_df %>%
  filter(organs == "Intestines" ) %>%
  pull(Probe),
  Multi_organ = final_overlap_df %>%
  filter(organs == "Multi_organ" ) %>%
  pull(Probe)

)

write.csv(best_cpg_overlap_all,here("results/overlap_all_selected_cpgs.csv"))
write.csv(best_cpg_overlap_single,here("results/overlap_single_selected_cpgs.csv"))
write.csv(best_selected_cpgs_organs$Brain,here("results/Brain_selected_cpgs.csv"))
write.csv(best_selected_cpgs_organs$Caudal_Fin,here("results/Fin_selected_cpgs.csv"))
write.csv(best_selected_cpgs_organs$Intestines,here("results/Intestine_selected_cpgs.csv"))
write.csv(best_selected_cpgs_organs$Multi_organ,here("results/Multi_organ_selected_cpgs.csv"))



Final_all_cpgs <- unique(c(
  best_cpg_overlap_all,
  best_cpg_overlap_single,
  best_selected_cpgs_organs$Brain,
  best_selected_cpgs_organs$Caudal_Fin,
  best_selected_cpgs_organs$Intestines,
  best_selected_cpgs_organs$Multi_organ
))
write.csv(Final_all_cpgs,here("results/All_robust_selected_cpgs.csv"))


Final_all_cpgs_df <- bind_rows(
  tibble(Probe = best_cpg_overlap_all,        ID = "overlap_all"),
  tibble(Probe = best_cpg_overlap_single,     ID = "overlap_single"),
  tibble(Probe = best_selected_cpgs_organs$Brain,        ID = "Brain"),
  tibble(Probe = best_selected_cpgs_organs$Caudal_Fin,   ID = "Caudal_Fin"),
  tibble(Probe = best_selected_cpgs_organs$Intestines,  ID = "Intestines"),
  tibble(Probe = best_selected_cpgs_organs$Multi_organ, ID = "Multi_organ")
)
write.csv(Final_all_cpgs_df,here("results/All_robust_selected_cpgs_df.csv"))
```
